test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: If the polynomial ax³ + 4x² + 3x - 4 and x³ - 7x + a leaves the same remainder, when divided by (x−2), then find the value of a.
solution:
**Given:**

P(x) = a x³ + 4x² + 3x - 4

Q(x) = x³ - 7x + a

Divisor = x - 2

P(2) = Q(2)

**Formula used:**

Remainder theorem: Remainder when divided by (x - c) = P(c)

**Calculation:**

⇒ P(2) = a(8) + 4(4) + 3(2) - 4

⇒ P(2) = 8a + 16 + 6 - 4

⇒ P(2) = 8a + 18

⇒ Q(2) = (8) - 14 + a

⇒ Q(2) = -6 + a

⇒ 8a + 18 = -6 + a

⇒ 7a = -24

⇒ a = -24 ÷ 7

**∴ a = -24/7**
